feeds.what: the offices on the ballot (id, code, name) plus statewide districts-reporting and the election's id/name
feeds.notes: EVERY response of this API is DOUBLE-ENCODED: the body is a JSON string whose content is JSON (JSON.parse twice), and some inner fields (DashboardMessage, ElectionDetails) are JSON strings again. Offices in 2026: 3 GOV Governor, 11 USC Representative in Congress, 12 STS Senator in the General Assembly, 13 STH Representative in the General Assembly.

feeds.what: all contests of one office with statewide totals per candidate — one request per office; there is no single all-contests document
feeds.notes: Same URL with officeId=3 (GetOfficeDetails-3.json, 2070 bytes, 1 contest), 12 (GetOfficeDetails-12.json, 34194 bytes, 25 contests), 13 (GetOfficeDetails-13.json, 252917 bytes, 203 contests). Shape: Election[<office name>][0]["<district name>$$<DistrictId>$$"][0] = {DistrictId, District, Candidates[]}. Four requests cover the whole election.

feeds.what: home-page summary (only the top race, Governor)
current election, and the list of all elections since 2000
feeds.notes: Returns [{ElectionID:117, ElectionName:'2026 General Election', ElectionDate:'2026-11-03T00:00:00', ElectionType:'G'}]. The full list is https://www.electionreturns.pa.gov/api/ElectionReturn/GetAllElections?methodName=GetAllElections (saved GetAllElections.json, 39134 bytes). Election detail/banner text: …/GetElectionTesting?methodName=GetElectionDetail&electionid=117&electiontype=G&isactive=1 (saved GetElectionDetail.json).

Returned "2026-11-10 18:29:08.157" when fetched at 23:29 UTC, i.e. it matched the moment of the request in Eastern time, so it may be server 'now' rather than the time of the last count. Treat with care.

feeds.what: the office's own 'Election Feed' (RSS for newsrooms): results by office, with county rows
feeds.notes: RSS 2.0, 246 <item>s (one per contest). The numbers are NOT XML: each <description> is a CDATA block holding an HTML <table> (County, Candidate Name, Party, Election Day Votes, Mail Votes, Provisional Votes, Total Votes, % of Vote), per county, with thousands separators in Total Votes. Feed ids come from /api/ElectionFeeds/GetElectionFeedList (saved; 81 by election, 82 by county, 83 by office) and the base from /api/ElectionFeeds/GetConfigData. ID=81 saved as electionFeed-81-by-election.xml (391470 bytes, a single item). Cache-Control: public. channel/lastBuildDate 'Nov 10 2026  4:23PM'.

election_id: electionid=117 with electiontype=G (query parameters), plus isactive=1. From GetLatestElection.
discovery: GET …/api/ElectionReturn/GetLatestElection?methodName=GetLatestElectionsData gives the current ElectionID and ElectionType; …/GetAllElections?methodName=GetAllElections lists every election (ids are reused across types: id 9 is both the 2000 primary 'P' and general 'G', so id+type is the key). Then GetOfficeNames for the office ids.
cors: none (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; the API also sends Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin)
bot_blocking: API and feeds: 200 with the plain relay User-Agent, no cookies (also 200 with a browser User-Agent on the one call tried both ways). But the site is behind Imperva/Incapsula (visid_incap_ / nlbi_ cookies) and the HTML page loads an obfuscated challenge script (src="/Built-with-the-For-hopence-Hurleysurfecting-the-") that posts an 'interrogation' and calls api.hcaptcha.com; headless Chrome never reached network idle on the page and made no API call. So the JSON API is open today, but a challenge could be switched on for it; requests were spaced 3-4 s apart.
updated_field: Best: RSS channel <lastBuildDate>Nov 10 2026  4:23PM</lastBuildDate> (no zone; Eastern). The JSON GetUpdatedTimeStamp returned "2026-11-10 18:29:08.157" (no zone, Eastern, and apparently the request time). GetOfficeDetails has no timestamp.
reporting_field: Statewide only, in GetOfficeNames Table1[0].DashboardMessage (a JSON string): "ReportingDistrict":"8932","VotingDistrict":"9065","Percentage":"98.53", with "DistrictMessage":" 8,932 Out of 9,065 Districts (98.53%)  - IN PERSON BALLOT REPORTING ONLY". No per-contest precincts in GetOfficeDetails. The RSS channel title repeats the statewide message.

choice_format: Separate fields, name in capitals, all values strings: {"OfficeName":"Governor","PartyName":"DEM","CandidateName":"JOSH SHAPIRO","Votes":"3019001","Percentage":"60.45","RunningMateName":"DAVIS, AUSTIN ","ElectionDayVotes":"2096410","MailInVotes":"916964","ProvisionalVotes":"5615"}. Yes/no contests (retention, questions) use the same row with YesVotes / NoVotes / YesVotesPercent / NoVotesPercent and IsRetention; none were on this ballot's office list, so that form was not seen with real numbers.
district_field: Separate: the office is one field (OfficeName) and the district another (District "1st Congressional District", plus DistrictId "2", an internal id that is NOT the district number: 1st Congressional = 2, 2nd Senatorial = 24, 1st Legislative = 73). The district number is only in the ordinal text (1st, 2nd, 3rd…). In the RSS feed the title joins them: "Representative in Congress (1st Congressional District)".
terms: none found on the results site. The RSS feed carries <copyright>Copyright 2026 PA-ENR Team</copyright>. The office's own instructions for the feed (GetElectionFeedsInstructions) invite reuse: "Pennsylvania makes its election night returns available via RSS … Subscribing to our feed removes the need to manually check our site for updated content." URL: https://www.electionreturns.pa.gov/ (Reports > Election Feed).
